faqs.question: How often should I have my windows professionally cleaned?
faqs.answer: For most residential properties, we recommend professional window cleaning every 3-6 months. Commercial properties may benefit from monthly or bi-monthly cleaning depending on location and environmental factors.

faqs.question: Do you clean both interior and exterior windows?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide comprehensive window cleaning services including both interior and exterior surfaces, frames, sills, and screens upon request.

faqs.question: What makes your window cleaning eco-friendly?
faqs.answer: We use biodegradable, non-toxic cleaning solutions that are safe for your family, pets, and the environment while still delivering professional results.

faqs.question: Do you provide window cleaning for high-rise buildings?
faqs.answer: We specialize in residential and low-rise commercial properties. For high-rise buildings, we can refer you to specialized partners who handle elevated window cleaning safely.

faqs.question: Is pressure washing safe for all surfaces?
faqs.answer: When performed by professionals, pressure washing is safe for most surfaces. We adjust pressure levels and techniques based on the specific surface material to prevent damage while ensuring effective cleaning.

faqs.question: How often should I pressure wash my property?
faqs.answer: Most residential properties benefit from annual pressure washing. Properties in areas with heavy rainfall, near trees, or with high traffic may need cleaning every 6-8 months.

faqs.question: Will pressure washing damage my plants or landscaping?
faqs.answer: We take precautions to protect your landscaping, including pre-watering plants and using plant-safe cleaning solutions. Our experienced team knows how to work around delicate areas.

faqs.question: What surfaces can you pressure wash?
faqs.answer: We can safely clean driveways, sidewalks, patios, decks, siding, fences, outdoor furniture, and many other exterior surfaces. Each surface receives appropriate treatment for optimal results.

house-washing.longDescription: Restore your home's beauty and protect your investment with our professional house washing services. We use gentle soft wash techniques and eco-friendly solutions to safely remove dirt, algae, mildew, and stains from all types of siding without damage.
benefits: Gentle soft wash technique prevents damage
Removes harmful algae, mold, and mildew
Increases curb appeal and property value

faqs.question: Is soft washing safe for my siding?
faqs.answer: Yes, soft washing uses low pressure and specialized cleaning solutions that are safe for vinyl, wood, stucco, brick, and other siding materials while being more effective than high-pressure washing.

faqs.question: How often should I have my house washed?
faqs.answer: Most homes benefit from professional washing annually, though homes in shaded areas or with heavy tree coverage may need cleaning every 6-8 months to prevent algae and mildew buildup.

faqs.question: Will house washing damage my plants?
faqs.answer: We take extensive precautions to protect your landscaping, including pre-watering plants, using plant-safe solutions, and covering delicate vegetation when necessary.

faqs.question: What's the difference between pressure washing and soft washing?
faqs.answer: Soft washing uses lower pressure and relies on specialized cleaning solutions to remove contaminants, making it safer for delicate surfaces while being more effective at killing organic growth.

Proper disposal of all collected debris

faqs.question: How often should gutters be cleaned?
faqs.answer: Most homes need gutter cleaning twice a year - once in late spring and once in late fall. Properties with many trees nearby may require more frequent cleaning.

faqs.question: Do you clean gutters in winter?
faqs.answer: We provide gutter cleaning year-round when weather conditions are safe. However, we recommend scheduling before winter storms to prevent ice dam formation.

faqs.question: What happens if you find damage during cleaning?
faqs.answer: We'll document any issues we discover and provide recommendations for repairs. While we focus on cleaning, we can refer you to trusted partners for gutter repairs or replacement.

faqs.question: Is gutter cleaning included with other services?
faqs.answer: Gutter cleaning can be bundled with our other exterior cleaning services for additional savings. Many customers combine it with pressure washing or window cleaning.

faqs.question: Is roof cleaning safe for my shingles?
faqs.answer: Yes, we use gentle, non-pressure methods specifically designed for different roofing materials. Our techniques remove contaminants without damaging shingles or other roofing components.

faqs.question: How often does moss treatment need to be reapplied?
faqs.answer: Our moss prevention treatments typically last 2-3 years depending on environmental conditions. We'll provide specific recommendations based on your roof's exposure and local climate.

faqs.question: Can you clean all types of roofing materials?
faqs.answer: We work with asphalt shingles, cedar shakes, tile, and metal roofing. Each material requires specific techniques, and we tailor our approach accordingly for optimal results.

faqs.question: Do you offer roof cleaning in wet weather?
faqs.answer: For safety reasons, we don't perform roof cleaning during wet or icy conditions. We'll reschedule to ensure both safety and cleaning effectiveness.

faqs.question: Can you remove old oil stains from concrete?
faqs.answer: Yes, we use specialized degreasers and techniques that can significantly improve or completely remove most oil stains, even older ones. Results depend on the stain's age and depth.

faqs.question: Is concrete cleaning safe for stamped or decorative concrete?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We adjust our pressure settings and use appropriate cleaning methods to safely clean decorative concrete without damaging patterns, colors, or sealers.

faqs.question: How often should concrete surfaces be cleaned?
faqs.answer: High-traffic areas like driveways benefit from annual cleaning, while walkways and patios may only need cleaning every 1-2 years depending on exposure and use.

faqs.question: Do you clean other masonry surfaces?
faqs.answer: Yes, we clean brick, stone, pavers, and other masonry surfaces using techniques appropriate for each material to ensure effective cleaning without damage.

faqs.question: Can you clean both wood and composite decking?
faqs.answer: Yes, we use specific techniques and cleaning solutions appropriate for each material - gentle methods for wood to prevent damage, and effective cleaning for composite materials.

faqs.question: Should I stain my deck after cleaning?
faqs.answer: For wood decks, staining or sealing after cleaning helps protect against weather and UV damage. We can provide recommendations and referrals for professional deck finishing services.

faqs.question: How often should decks and fences be cleaned?
faqs.answer: Annual cleaning is recommended for most decks and fences, though structures in shaded areas or high-moisture environments may benefit from cleaning every 6-12 months.

faqs.question: Do you move deck furniture before cleaning?
faqs.answer: We can move lightweight furniture as part of our service. For heavy or valuable items, we ask that you arrange to have them moved before our scheduled cleaning.

faqs.question: How often should solar panels be cleaned?
faqs.answer: Most residential solar panels benefit from cleaning 2-4 times per year, depending on local environmental conditions, nearby trees, and weather patterns.

faqs.question: Will cleaning void my panel warranty?
faqs.answer: Our gentle cleaning methods are designed to preserve manufacturer warranties. We follow industry best practices and use appropriate techniques for each panel type.

faqs.question: Can dirty panels really reduce efficiency that much?
faqs.answer: Yes, studies show that dirty panels can lose 15-25% efficiency. In dusty or high-pollen areas, the reduction can be even greater, making regular cleaning a wise investment.

faqs.question: Do you work on all types of solar installations?
faqs.answer: We service most residential and commercial solar panel installations. We'll assess your system during scheduling to ensure we can safely and effectively clean your specific setup.
